entities.summary: Tel Abel Beth Maacah is a large archaeological tell with a small upper northern section and a large lower southern one, connected by a saddle. It is located on the northern border of present-day Israel, about 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) south of the town of Metula and about 6.5 kilometres (4.0 mi) west of Tel Dan.
